name: Skill Review
description: Runs the SkillzForest reviewer on an agent skill — from a local folder, a .zip, a SKILL.md or a URL (GitHub repo or folder, direct link): static checks, scanners, LLM auditors of SKILL.md and of the other files, a functional test in a sandboxed Claude Code, a judge and a pass / warn / fail verdict. Locally right away, or through the back office's n8n chain.
